source_batches.integrity_note: Independent preregistered retrospective day; weaker result retained without retune.

heterogeneity.finding: The two independent exact-335m retrospective days differ materially. Pooled performance is moderate, but day-to-day heterogeneity is too large to justify tuning from either day or claiming stable 335m performance from retrospective evidence alone.

conclusion: Exact-335m retrospective evidence is heterogeneous: pooled n=20 top1 35%, winner Top3 70%, weighted log loss 1.74501. The already-frozen genuine prospective Maebashi 2026-09-12 R1-R9 is therefore the decisive next evidence rather than further retrospective tuning.
